limitations_and_boundaries: The study primarily uses the PS19 tauopathy mouse model; generalizability to other tauopathy models or human AD requires further validation.
C3aR-KO is global; cell-type-specific contributions of C3aR signaling are not fully dissected.
The pharmacological STAT3 inhibitor SH-4-54 may have off-target effects.
Human AD network analysis is correlational and does not establish causality.
Sample sizes for some experiments (e.g., n=6) are modest.
